subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Despite multiple obstacles, she continued with her endeavour, demonstrating that she has __nerves of steel__.

options.text: An absence of fear or anxiety
The capacity to maintain composure when stressed

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"nerves of steel"** means the ability to remain calm and composed, especially in stressful or dangerous situations. (धैर्य और साहस)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite the turbulence, the pilot, with** nerves of steel**, successfully landed the plane.
 
 
 
• **"The capacity to maintain composure when stressed"** refers to staying calm and collected under pressure. (तनाव में शांत रहना)
 
 
• **Example: **Surgeons need to have the capacity **to maintain composure when stressed to perform successful operations.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is **'The capacity to maintain composure when stressed.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Extraordinary beauty** (असाधारण सुंदरता): Exceptional or remarkable beauty.

 
 
• **Example:** The** extraordinary beauty** of the sunset left everyone in awe.
 
 
 
• **An absence of fear or anxiety** (डर या चिंता की अनुपस्थिति): The state of being without fear or anxiety.
 
 
• **Example:** His **absence of fear** or anxiety in the face of danger was truly remarkable.
 
 
 
• **Relentless determination** (अविरल दृढ़ संकल्प): Unyielding or persistent determination.
 
 
• **Example:** Her **relentless determination** helped her overcome all obstacles in her path.
 
 

3c:Tc3c,

The correct answer is **Option 1)**
